0022600230.text: The Phoenix Suns host the Charlotte Hornets in the Suns' 11th game of the season, with both teams already 4-6 after 10 games. Phoenix is 4-3 at home and 0-3 on the road, sitting 3rd in the Pacific, 5 games back, and 11th in the West, while Charlotte is 3-4 at home and 1-2 on the road, sitting 3rd in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 9th in the East. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury that required surgery, and Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, all out with hamstring injuries, while Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with no games played yet this season, and their most recent meeting came on April 2, 2026 in Charlotte, when the Suns lost 127-107.
